name: card
title: Card
description: Flat surface card with one radius and theme-defined shadow character.
docs: One card, one radius, no variant table by design; visual character comes entirely from the theme (`--uifa-surface`, `--uifa-radius-control`, `--uifa-shadow-char`). Parts: `[data-uifa-slot="title"]`, `[data-uifa-slot="body"]`, `[data-uifa-slot="actions"]`. Compose buttons or badges into the slots.
